title: PermitReporter — Georgia Permit Intelligence
description: Source-linked Georgia permit search, county coverage, contractor signals, and authorized watches.
summary: Source-linked Georgia permit search, county coverage, contractor signals, and authorized watches.
offersHint: Source-linked Georgia permit search, county coverage, contractor signals, and authorized watches. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://permitreporter.com/mcp

toolsPreview.name: search
toolsPreview.description: Search PermitReporter reviewed guidance and privacy-minimized collected building-permit records. Returns canonical URLs for citation. Call fetch with a returned ID for the full source.

toolsPreview.name: fetch
toolsPreview.description: Fetch one reviewed PermitReporter guide or one collected permit record returned by search. Permit records retain source, record date, collection timestamp and coverage limits.

toolsPreview.name: search_georgia_permits
toolsPreview.description: Search privacy-minimized collected building-permit records by public text, Georgia county, city, PermitReporter trade classification or record-date range. Returns no raw payloads or party arrays. An empty result means no matching record was collected, not that no permit exists.

toolsPreview.name: get_permit_record
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve one privacy-minimized collected building-permit record by PermitReporter record ID, including its canonical citation, official source link and collection timestamp.

toolsPreview.name: get_county_coverage
toolsPreview.description: Return the current source route, issuer, cadence, lag, through-date, collected record count, sources and statistical floor for one of Georgia's 159 counties. Call this before interpreting a missing county result.

toolsPreview.name: get_contractor_leads
toolsPreview.description: Return recent, source-linked collected permits classified by trade and project scope for contractor research. Classifications are editorial signals, not official fields or guaranteed work.

toolsPreview.name: get_statewide_snapshot
toolsPreview.description: Return current PermitReporter counts, route-status boundaries, record-date range and latest collection timestamp without returning personal data.

toolsPreview.name: create_permit_watch
toolsPreview.description: Create a pending email watch only after the user reviews the exact email, search query and optional county, explicitly authorizes this request and confirmation email, and accepts https://permitreporter.com/terms and https://permitreporter.com/privacy. This additive action stores the email and search for alerts; it does not file a permit or prove coverage. The address must confirm before alerts begin. Reuse submission_id for safe retries.
